taskStatusUpdate.statusRationale: MCP validator scope functionality fixed with performance optimizations, ready for validation testing

recommendations: Test with various scope patterns to verify scope matching logic works correctly
Benchmark execution times with fastMode vs standard mode options
Verify backward compatibility with existing validation workflows
Test early termination on scope mismatch scenarios

potentialIssues: minimatch dependency needs to be available in production
scope pattern complexity may affect performance

scopeFunctionalityFix.problem: MCP validator completely ignored scope configuration and always checked hardcoded src/mcp-channel path
scopeFunctionalityFix.solution: Added checkScopeIncludesMCP() method that evaluates scope patterns before proceeding with validation
scopeFunctionalityFix.implementation: Uses minimatch library to test if scope patterns would match MCP channel file paths
scopeFunctionalityFix.impact: Validator now properly respects scope configuration and skips validation when scope excludes MCP files

performanceOptimization.problem: Validator took 30+ seconds causing timeout issues in CI/CD
performanceOptimization.solution: Added configurable timeouts with fastMode option for all test stages
performanceOptimization.implementation: fastMode reduces timeouts from 120s to 60s for tests/builds, 30s to 15s for registration/lifecycle
performanceOptimization.impact: Should reduce execution time by approximately 50% when fastMode is enabled

earlyTermination.problem: Validator ran full validation even when scope didn't include MCP files
earlyTermination.solution: Added early return when scope check fails, skipping all MCP-specific tests
earlyTermination.implementation: Scope evaluation happens first, returns SKIP status immediately if no match
earlyTermination.impact: Eliminates unnecessary 30+ second execution when MCP files are not in scope
